description: Mixer and gate expander for Groove Box, placed immediately to the left of it, adding mute, solo, level, pan and pitch per track and a trigger output per track

params.text: Silences that track of Groove Box
Leaves only the soloed tracks of Groove Box sounding
Sets the level of that track, from silence through unity at the centre to twice the level
Places that track in the stereo field, hard left through centre to hard right
Shifts the playback speed of that track, -1 to 1

inputs.text: Any voltage other than 0V mutes that track, alongside its mute button

outputs.text: A 10ms 10V trigger each time that track of Groove Box plays a step

notes: nothing is sent or received unless Groove Box is the module immediately to the right
menu: Exclusive Solo — on a SOLO button's own right-click menu, not the panel menu: solos that track and clears the solo on every other
Unsolo All — on a SOLO button's own right-click menu, not the panel menu: clears the solo on every track
Unmute All — on a MUTE button's own right-click menu, not the panel menu: clears the mute on every track
